lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਪਨੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih srapanee taa kee keetee hoee ||
lines.translation: This she-serpent is created by Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲੁ ਅਬਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: bal abal kiaa is te hoee ||4||
lines.translation: What power or weakness does she have by herself? ||4||
If she abides with the mortal, then his soul abides in his body.
By Guru's Grace, Kabeer has easily crossed over. ||5||6||19||
Aasaa:
Why bother to read the Simritees to a dog?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਸਾਕਤ ਪਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa saakat pahi har gun gaae ||1||
lines.translation: Why bother to sing the Lord's Praises to the faithless cynic? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੇ ਰਮਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam raam raam rame ram raheeai ||
lines.translation: Remain absorbed in the Lord's Name, Raam, Raam, Raam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਭੂਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat siu bhool nahee kaheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Do not bother to speak of it to the faithless cynic, even by mistake. ||1||Pause||
Why offer camphor to a crow?
Why give the snake milk to drink? ||2||
Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, discriminating understanding is attained.
That iron which touches the Philosopher's Stone becomes gold. ||3||
The dog, the faithless cynic, does everything as the Lord causes him to do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa s karam kamaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: He does the deeds pre-ordained from the very beginning. ||4||
If you take Ambrosial Nectar and irrigate the neem tree with it,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥੭॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer uaa ko sahaj na jaaee ||5||7||20||
lines.translation: still, says Kabeer, its natural qualities are not changed. ||5||7||20||
Aasaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੰਕਾ ਸਾ ਕੋਟੁ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸੀ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: la(n)kaa saa kot samu(n)d see khaaee ||
lines.translation: A fortress like that of Sri Lanka, with the ocean as a moat around it

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tih raavan ghar khabar na paaee ||1||
lines.translation: - there is no news about that house of Raavan. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaaee ||
lines.translation: What shall I ask for? Nothing is permanent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਨੈਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekhat nain chalio jag jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I see with my eyes that the world is passing away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਲਖੁ ਪੂਤ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ ਨਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik lakh poot savaa lakh naatee ||
lines.translation: Thousands of sons and thousands of grandsons

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਰਾਵਨ ਘਰ ਦੀਆ ਨ ਬਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tih raavan ghar deeaa na baatee ||2||
lines.translation: - but in that house of Raavan, the lamps and wicks have gone out. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਤਪਤ ਰਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)d sooraj jaa ke tapat rasoee ||
lines.translation: The moon and the sun cooked his food.
The fire washed his clothes. ||3||
Under Guru's Instructions, one whose mind is filled with the Lord's Name,
becomes permanent, and does not go anywhere. ||4||
Says Kabeer, listen, people:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥੮॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam bin mukat na hoee ||5||8||21||
lines.translation: without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated. ||5||8||21||
Aasaa:
First, the son was born, and then, his mother.
The guru falls at the feet of the disciple. ||1||
Listen to this wonderful thing, O Siblings of Destiny!
I saw the lion herding the cows. ||1||Pause||
The fish of the water gives birth upon a tree.
I saw a cat carrying away a dog. ||2||
The branches are below, and the roots are above.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪੇਡਿ ਲਗੇ ਫਲ ਫੂਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis kai ped lage phal phoolaa ||3||
lines.translation: The trunk of that tree bears fruits and flowers. ||3||
Riding a horse, the buffalo takes him out to graze.
The bull is away, while his load has come home. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੁ ਇਸ ਪਦ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat kabeer j is pad boojhai ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, one who understands this hymn,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਮਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੫॥੯॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam ramat tis sabh kichh soojhai ||5||9||22||
lines.translation: and chants the Lord's Name, comes to understand everything. ||5||9||22||
22 Chau-Padhay And Panch-Padhay

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ਤਿਪਦੇ ੮ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ ੭ ਇਕਤੁਕਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa sree kabeer jeeu ke tipade 8 dutuke 7 ikatukaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa Of Kabeer Jee, 8 Thri-Padhay, 7 Dho-Thukay, 1 Ik-Tuka:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿੰਦੁ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਕੀਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੁੰਡ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bi(n)d te jin pi(n)d keeaa agan ku(n)d rahaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord created the body from sperm, and protected it in the fire pit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਮਾਤਾ ਉਦਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: das maas maataa udar raakhiaa bahur laagee maaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: For ten months He preserved you in your mother's womb, and then, after you were born, you became attached to Maya. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanee kaahe kau lobh laage ratan janam khoiaa ||
lines.translation: O mortal, why have you attached yourself to greed, and lost the jewel of life?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਬੋਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab janam karam bhoom beej naahee boiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You did not plant the seeds of good actions in the earth of your past lives. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਹੋਨਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: baarik te biradh bhaiaa honaa so hoiaa ||
lines.translation: From an infant, you have grown old. That which was to happen, has happened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਝੋਟ ਪਕਰੈ ਤਬਹਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa jam aai jhot pakarai tabahi kaahe roiaa ||2||
lines.translation: When the Messenger of Death comes and grabs you by your hair, why do you cry out then? ||2||
